view_claims.claim: Pydantic v2's model_copy(update=...) does not validate the supplied update values before creating the copied model.
Pydantic 2.13.5's JsonValue union uses a discriminator with list, dict, string, boolean, integer, float and null variants, and has no tuple variant.
SQLite permits one simultaneous write transaction, and BEGIN IMMEDIATE starts a write transaction immediately or can fail with SQLITE_BUSY when another writer is active.
SQLite trigger execution of RAISE(ABORT, message) terminates the triggering statement and returns SQLITE_CONSTRAINT with the supplied message.
Python 3.12's standard-library hashlib includes sha256 and supports hexadecimal hash output through hexdigest.
RFC 8785 sorts JSON object property names by UTF-16 code units and requires UTF-8 encoding of the resulting serialization.
